vercel-labs.en: Vercel Labs explores developer tools and public experiments, including Agent Skills, browser automation, and generative interfaces for building and testing software.
vercel-labs.zh: 探索开发者工具与公开实验，作品涵盖 Agent Skills、浏览器自动化和生成式界面，服务软件构建与验证。

morluto.en: morluto creates REA and other agent tools for investigating software behavior, analyzing performance, and preparing project resources from inspectable source material.
morluto.zh: REA 作者，围绕软件行为调查、性能分析与 Agent 工具开展开发，并发布逆向工程和项目分享图相关指引。

anthropics.en: Anthropic develops Claude and publishes developer resources, including Claude Code, application examples, and Skills for design, documents, authoring, and testing workflows.
anthropics.zh: 开发 Claude，并公开编程工具资料、应用示例和任务指引，涵盖界面设计、文档处理、Skill 编写与网页测试。

heygen-com.en: HeyGen builds AI video products and publishes tools including HyperFrames and a video API CLI, connecting visual composition, media preparation, and rendering workflows.
heygen-com.zh: 开发 AI 视频产品，公开作品包括 HyperFrames、视频 API CLI 与配套指引，覆盖画面编排和渲染。

mattpocock.en: Matt Pocock teaches TypeScript and builds engineering tools and Skills, covering software planning, testing, debugging, agent orchestration, and practical development workflows.
mattpocock.zh: TypeScript 教育者与开发者，作品涵盖工程 Skills、Agent 编排和类型工具，关注规划、测试与调试。

emilkowalski.en: Emil Kowalski explores design engineering through React components, animation writing, and Agent Skills focused on interface quality, interaction details, and practical review.
emilkowalski.zh: 专注设计工程，作品包括 React 组件、动效写作与界面 Skills，关注产品交互、视觉细节和实际界面质量。

coreyhaines31.en: Corey Haines works across SaaS marketing, design, and publishing, sharing growth methods through Marketing Skills, Conversion Factory, and the SwipeFiles newsletter.
coreyhaines31.zh: 从事 SaaS 增长营销与设计，发布营销 Skills，并通过客户服务、通讯和案例分享内容、转化与增长方法。

juliusbrussee.en: Julius Brussee builds Caveman tools and Skills for agent efficiency, alongside Revu, a local-first macOS application for structured study and spaced repetition.
juliusbrussee.zh: 构建 Caveman 工具与 Skills，探索 Agent 信息处理效率；另有面向间隔复习的 Revu 学习应用。

microsoft.en: Microsoft publishes development tools, languages, and cloud resources, including Azure Skills, Visual Studio Code, and TypeScript for application development, deployment, and diagnostics.
microsoft.zh: 发布开发工具、语言与云端资源，代表作品包括 Azure Skills、VS Code 和 TypeScript。

open.feishu.cn.en: Feishu Open Platform connects workplace services through APIs, its CLI, and Agent Skills for documents, tables, calendars, meetings, and everyday team collaboration.
open.feishu.cn.zh: 通过 API、CLI 与 Agent Skills 连接办公服务，涵盖文档、表格、日历和会议整理，支持团队协作。

remotion-dev.en: Remotion brings video creation into React, with a framework and Agent Skills covering composition, animation, interactive previews, rendering, and integration into applications.
remotion-dev.zh: 将视频制作连接到 React，框架与配套指引覆盖画面合成、动画、预览和渲染，支持可编辑、可复用的视频工作流。

leonxlnx.en: Leon Lin develops design Skills and tools for coding agents, with public work including Taste Skill, the TasteCode workspace, and earshot audio tools.
leonxlnx.zh: 发布界面设计指引与 Agent 工具，作品包括 Taste Skill、TasteCode 和 earshot，连接设计与编码。

obra.en: Jesse Vincent builds Superpowers and agent tools, organizing software work around planning, tests, debugging, code review, and reusable engineering practices for coding agents.
obra.zh: 构建 Superpowers 与 Agent 工具，将软件开发组织为规划、测试、调试和代码审查，沉淀可复用的工程方法。

pbakaus.en: Paul Bakaus builds design tools for coding agents, including Impeccable, extending interface guidance with focused commands, browser review, and practical design workflows.
pbakaus.zh: 构建设计工具与指引，代表作品 Impeccable 通过专项命令、浏览器审查和设计流程，改善 Agent 界面质量。

cloudflare.en: Cloudflare builds network infrastructure and developer tools, with public projects spanning the Workers runtime, protocol implementations, and Agent instructions for structured code security audits.
cloudflare.zh: 构建网络基础设施与开发者工具，公开项目涵盖 Workers 运行时、协议实现和 Agent 安全审查指引。

googleworkspace.en: Google Workspace CLI connects Drive, Gmail, Calendar, and other services with command-line tools and Agent Skills; its repository explicitly notes the product is not officially supported.
googleworkspace.zh: 通过 CLI 与 Skills 连接云端文档、邮件和日历；仓库明确说明该产品不由 Google 官方提供支持。

firecrawl.en: Firecrawl develops web data tools for agents, connecting search, scraping, crawling, and structured extraction through its main platform, CLI, and task-focused instructions.
firecrawl.zh: 为 Agent 提供网页数据工具，围绕搜索、抓取、站点遍历和结构化提取，连接主项目、CLI 与具体任务指引。

supabase.en: Supabase builds a PostgreSQL application platform and publishes Agent Skills for database design, query performance, security, and practical integration with backend services and tools.
supabase.zh: 构建 PostgreSQL 应用平台，并发布数据库设计、查询性能与安全相关 Skills，连接后端服务和开发流程。

github.en: GitHub hosts Awesome Copilot, a community-created collection of agents, instructions, Skills, and configurations for adapting coding workflows to different projects and development tasks.
github.zh: 托管社区共同构建的 Awesome Copilot，汇集 Agents、Skills 和开发指引，服务编码与协作流程。

trailofbits.en: Trail of Bits publishes security research tools and Agent Skills for code analysis, vulnerability investigation, testing, and evidence-based audit workflows across software projects.
trailofbits.zh: 发布安全研究工具与 Agent Skills，涵盖代码分析、漏洞调查和测试方法，通过证据组织软件审查与审计流程。

openai.en: OpenAI develops AI systems and developer tools. Explore Codex, its open agent harness for coding tasks, tool use, and application integration.
openai.zh: OpenAI 开发 AI 系统与开发工具。通过 Codex 了解开放 Agent 运行层、代码任务、工具使用和应用集成。

deepseek-ai.en: DeepSeek publishes agent infrastructure and research prototypes. Explore Harness for runtime composition and DSH Superagent for GitHub-driven coding workflows.
deepseek-ai.zh: DeepSeek 的 Agent 项目：Harness 插件化运行层与 Superagent 仓库任务协作原型。

earendil-works.en: Earendil Works hosts Pi’s current upstream. Explore its extensible agent harness, coding CLI, and reusable libraries for model access and agent execution.
earendil-works.zh: Earendil Works 维护 Pi 的当前上游。通过 Pi 了解可扩展 Agent 运行层、编程 CLI 与基础库。

anomalyco.en: Anomaly publishes OpenCode, an open-source coding agent. Explore its interactive developer workflow, official source, and the boundary between application tools and model services.
anomalyco.zh: Anomaly 发布开源编程 Agent OpenCode。通过代表项目了解交互式开发、官方源码与模型服务之间的边界。

nousresearch.en: Nous Research publishes Hermes Agent. Explore a system combining persistent memory, reusable Skills, connected tools, and scheduling for work that continues across sessions.
nousresearch.zh: Nous Research 发布 Hermes Agent。通过代表项目了解持久记忆、Skills、工具连接与持续工作。

moonshotai.en: Moonshot AI develops Kimi and publishes Kimi Code CLI. Explore its terminal coding agent, plugin ecosystem, editor integration, and the transition from the legacy CLI.
moonshotai.zh: 月之暗面开发 Kimi 并发布编程 Agent。通过 Kimi Code CLI 了解终端协作、插件生态与编辑器集成。

zai-org.en: Z.ai publishes ZCode, a coding workbench and agent harness. Explore its desktop, Web, and terminal experiences, public runtime source, and GLM ecosystem context.
zai-org.zh: Z.ai 发布编程工作台与 Agent Harness ZCode。通过代表项目了解桌面、Web、终端入口及公开运行时。

dietrichgebert.en: Creates Ponytail: reuse-first coding rules, change reviews, and repository audits for existing agents.
dietrichgebert.zh: 维护 Ponytail，以代码复用、修改审查和仓库审计改进编程 Agent 的工作方式。

milind-soni.en: Maintains MausBot / OpenMausBot, a desktop app for role-based agents, shared channels, and reviewable execution.
milind-soni.zh: 维护 MausBot / OpenMausBot，通过桌面应用组织角色 Agent、共享频道与可审阅执行。

comfy-org.en: Develops ComfyUI and its open ecosystem for node-based generative-media workflows.
comfy-org.zh: 维护 ComfyUI 及相关开源生态，通过节点图组织生成媒体与可复用制作流程。

graphify-labs.en: Develops Graphify’s code knowledge graphs, local tooling, and agent integrations.
graphify-labs.zh: 开发 Graphify 代码知识图谱、本地工具与 Agent 集成，帮助调查仓库关系。

stablyai.en: Publishes Orca, a workspace for parallel coding agents, isolated worktrees, and code review.
stablyai.zh: 发布 Orca，通过并行编程 Agent、独立 worktree 与代码审阅组织开发任务。

nvidia.en: Publishes AI infrastructure and developer tools, including a semantic layer for enterprise data.
nvidia.zh: 发布 AI 基础设施与开发工具，包括面向企业数据的语义层框架。

storytold.en: Publishes creative software and Rust tools for editing media, inspecting interfaces, and building prototypes.
storytold.zh: 发布创意软件和 Rust 工具，覆盖媒体编辑、界面取证与原型重建。

opencut-app.en: Builds an open-source video editor and maintains the upstream Rust rewrite.
opencut-app.zh: 发布开源视频编辑器 OpenCut，并在主仓库推进 Rust 版重写。

calesthio.en: Publishes OpenMontage, a source toolkit for planning, assembling and reviewing video with a coding agent.
calesthio.zh: 发布 OpenMontage，帮助编程 Agent 规划、组装和检查视频。

nexu-io.en: Publishes an open-source design workspace and reusable packages for agent-assisted design.
nexu-io.zh: 发布开源设计工作区，以及供 Agent 使用的设计系统和模板。

thedotmack.en: Creates Claude-Mem, a memory tool that helps coding agents recover context across sessions.
thedotmack.zh: 开发 Claude-Mem，帮助编程 Agent 在新会话中找回之前的工作上下文。

mksglu.en: Maintains Context Mode, a local plugin for keeping large tool results searchable outside an agent’s context.
mksglu.zh: 维护 Context Mode，将大体积工具输出保存在 Agent 上下文之外供检索。

ayghri.en: Publishes I Have ADHD, an Agent Skill for clear next actions and visible progress.
ayghri.zh: 发布 I Have ADHD Skill，让 Agent 清楚给出下一步，并保留任务进度。

othmanadi.en: Publishes Planning with Files, an open-source workflow for tracking long-running agent tasks in project files.
othmanadi.zh: 发布 Planning with Files，用项目文件跟踪 Agent 的长任务。

karpathy.en: Publishes Autoresearch for agent-run model training and the LLM Wiki pattern for maintaining linked Markdown knowledge.
karpathy.zh: 公开 Autoresearch 自动训练实验和 LLM Wiki 设计，探索用 Agent 迭代模型与维护知识库。

sherlock-project.en: Maintains Sherlock, a command-line tool for checking public username matches across supported websites and exporting candidates for review.
sherlock-project.zh: 维护开源用户名搜索工具 Sherlock，提供网站查询规则和可供复核的公开候选链接。

k-dense-ai.en: Maintains Scientific Agent Skills for data inspection, statistical analysis, visualization, and scientific writing in supported Agent hosts.
k-dense-ai.zh: 维护 Scientific Agent Skills，为 Codex、Cursor 等宿主提供数据检查、统计分析和科研写作指引。

openclaw.en: Maintains the OpenClaw agent runtime, Gateway, and headless CLI for tasks with explicit workspace and tool access.
openclaw.zh: 维护 OpenClaw Agent 运行环境、Gateway 与无界面 CLI，支持在明确权限内执行任务。

affaan-m.en: Publishes ECC, a cross-host toolkit for coding-agent Skills, hooks, guided setup, and diagnostics.
affaan-m.zh: 发布跨宿主配置工具 ECC，涵盖编程 Agent 的 Skills、Hooks、引导安装和诊断。

garrytan.en: Maintains gstack workflows for product review, engineering, QA, and release, including a report-only workflow for reproducible findings.
garrytan.zh: 维护 gstack 工程工作流，覆盖产品评审、QA 与发布，并提供保留可复现证据的报告模式。

addyosmani.en: Publishes practical engineering Skills, including a DevTools workflow for reproducing browser defects and capturing runtime evidence.
addyosmani.zh: 发布面向工程实践的 Agent Skills，其中 DevTools 工作流可复现页面缺陷并保存运行时证据。

adobe.en: Adobe publishes creative-tool Skills and React Spectrum libraries, connecting product-specific agent guidance with accessible interface development.
adobe.zh: 发布创意工具 Skills 与 React Spectrum 组件库，分别面向 Adobe 产品操作和无障碍界面开发。

aws.en: AWS maintains an agent toolkit combining cloud-development instructions, MCP servers and plugins for working with AWS services.
aws.zh: 维护面向云开发的 Agent 工具包，包含 AWS 服务操作指引、MCP 服务与插件。

google-gemini.en: The google-gemini organization publishes Gemini API Skills and Gemini CLI, separating reusable API guidance from the terminal agent.
google-gemini.zh: 发布 Gemini API Skills 和 Gemini CLI，分别提供 API 开发指引与终端 Agent。

google-labs-code.en: Google Labs Code maintains Stitch design Skills and plugins, with host-specific setup documented in its own repositories.
google-labs-code.zh: 维护 Stitch 设计 Skills 与插件，由独立仓库说明各 Agent 宿主的安装方式。

firebase.en: Firebase publishes product-specific agent instructions for building applications, with official documentation linking to its agent-skills repository.
firebase.zh: 发布应用开发相关的 Agent 指引，官方文档明确链接 firebase/agent-skills 来源仓库。

huggingface.en: Hugging Face publishes AI and ML task Skills covering dataset creation, model training, evaluation and Hub operations.
huggingface.zh: 发布数据集创建、模型训练、评估及 Hub 操作相关的 AI 与机器学习任务 Skills。

mongodb.en: MongoDB maintains database software and official agent Skills, with separate Atlas and self-managed connection paths.
mongodb.zh: 维护数据库软件与官方 Agent Skills，分别说明 Atlas 和自管理部署的连接方式。

redis.en: Redis publishes server software and agent instructions for data structures, key design, memory, expiration and related application decisions.
redis.zh: 发布 Redis 软件及 Agent 指引，涉及数据结构、键设计、内存、过期策略与应用选型。

stripe.en: Stripe publishes agent plugins and Skills alongside payment SDKs; integration instructions, API clients and hosted services have distinct roles.
stripe.zh: 发布 Agent 插件、Skills 与支付 SDK，分别承担集成指引、API 调用及服务接入职责。

shopify.en: Shopify’s AI Toolkit connects agents to developer documentation, API schemas and code validation, alongside separate Shopify CLI tooling.
shopify.zh: AI Toolkit 连接开发文档、API Schema 与代码校验，另有独立的 Shopify CLI 软件工具。

figma.en: Figma’s MCP guide documents design context and agent workflows, with access conditions and developer terms distinct from source-code availability.
figma.zh: MCP 指南说明设计上下文与 Agent 工作流，访问条件和开发者条款需与代码可见性分开判断。

makenotion.en: Notion publishes Skills and its JavaScript API client under makenotion, separating agent instructions from application integration code.
makenotion.zh: 以 makenotion 组织发布 Skills 与 JavaScript API 客户端，分别维护任务指引和集成代码。

datadog.en: The DataDog organization maintains Datadog Agent software; experimental AI Skills belong to the separate Datadog Labs organization.
datadog.zh: 维护 Datadog Agent 监控软件；实验性 AI Skills 属于独立的 Datadog Labs 组织。

datadog-labs.en: Datadog Labs publishes experimental AI Skills under its own GitHub organization, with an explicit boundary from Datadog product support.
datadog-labs.zh: 以独立 GitHub 组织发布实验性 AI Skills，明确区别于 Datadog 正式产品支持。

getsentry.en: Sentry separates employee development Skills from product-focused agent plugin sources, all under the getsentry GitHub organization.
getsentry.zh: 在 getsentry 组织下分别维护员工开发 Skills、面向产品的 Agent 插件来源和 Sentry 应用。

hashicorp.en: HashiCorp publishes Terraform and Packer agent instructions alongside infrastructure software, with licenses and execution requirements checked per repository.
hashicorp.zh: 发布 Terraform 与 Packer Agent 指引及基础设施软件，许可与运行要求按仓库分别核对。
